title: Perception in the mode of causal efficacy

statements.text: Besides perception in the mode of presentational immediacy, the projected sense data of the five senses, there is a more primordial bodily perception in the mode of causal efficacy, the felt influence of the past and of the body, which modern science has largely ignored. It is the clue that energy elsewhere in nature is analogous to felt experience.

sources.quote: It is this latter form of human experience that modern science has all but ignored.
